# Riskium

Riskium is a conceptual ontology for organizing organizational risk knowledge. It distinguishes a continuing **RiskCase** from its register entries, possible scenarios, occurrences, contextual assessments, decisions and evidence. The ontology's domain is general; the pharmaceutical literature corpus is a development case, not its defining domain or an independently validated organizational deployment.

**Published source:** [v0.3.8](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/releases/tag/v0.3.8) · **conceptual model and OWL:** 0.3.1 · **published reader:** 0.4.7 · **author-held article candidate:** [7.2.3 receipt](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/evaluation/manuscript-review/v7.2.3/receipt.json). The article's Word/PDF are supplied to the author separately; they are not assets of the published source distribution. [Artifact roles](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/documentation/0.4.7/guides/Artifact-Versions.md) and the [manuscript/release roadmap](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/docs/manuscript-and-release-roadmap.md) explain the distinct version numbers.

[Read the Pages guide](https://arazsaiearasi3.github.io/riskium/current/index.html) · [Browse concepts](https://arazsaiearasi3.github.io/riskium/current/concepts/index.html) · [Open the Wiki](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/wiki) · [Explore the conceptual reference](https://arazsaiearasi3.github.io/riskium/current/reference/native/index.html) · [Download v0.3.8](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/releases/tag/v0.3.8)

**Verified package:** v0.3.8 selects 32 component families. All six uploaded assets were independently downloaded and verified against the exact source, component closure and unchanged predecessor inventory. The [publication record](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/evaluation/releases/v0.3.8/publication.json) retains those observations; [#76](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/issues/76) records current-channel reconciliation.

| Reproduce and assess results | [Reproduction guide](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/documentation/0.4.7/guides/Reproduce.md), [source-aware CI policy](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/docs/source-transition-validation.md) | [Experiments and workflow inventory](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/docs/experiment-and-flow-inventory.md), [claim-based quality report](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/evaluation/quality/README.md), [release/channel checklist](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/docs/publication-consistency-checklist.md) |
| Use the relational companion | [Database assurance](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/docs/relational-assurance.md) | [Risk-nature SQL profile](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/implementation/relational/0.9.0/README.md) and [traceability](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/docs/traceability.md) |

The source catalog is [ontology/riskium-model.json](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/ontology/riskium-model.json). Its eleven subdomains organize one overall domain. The [native OntoUML exchange](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/ontology/native/riskium.ontouml.json), [typed OWL projection](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/ontology/derived/riskium.owl.ttl), [requirements](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/requirements/ontology-requirements.md) and [evidence](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/evaluation/README.md) have different roles. Passing a structural, reasoning, SHACL or SQL check does not establish an overall semantic-correctness percentage. Independent semantic review is tracked in [#23](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/issues/23), and independently prepared literature case populations remain [#13](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/issues/13).

## Citation, rights and status

The authors are Araz Saie Arasi, Hassan Haghighi and Hossein Azgomi; use [CITATION.cff](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/CITATION.cff) and [AUTHORS.md](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/AUTHORS.md) for exact attribution. Original research content uses CC BY 4.0 and original software uses MIT; [RIGHTS.md](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/RIGHTS.md) and [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/NOTICE.md) identify retained third-party terms. The repository does not redistribute the privately held literature PDFs or pharmaceutical case database.

The [release roadmap](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/blob/main/docs/manuscript-and-release-roadmap.md) keeps subsequent evidence work and the finite first-major-release goal separate from published v0.3.8. Full native-to-SQL mapping, independent expert ratings and general enterprise/holding/ecosystem use validation remain open. [Open issues](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/issues) record the remaining work.
